$comment: TASK-197 (audit D-6): every credential this repository and its deployments hold, with when it expires — never a value. Read by scripts/check-credential-expiry.mjs (weekly, .github/workflows/credential-expiry.yml): a date within leadDays, or past, fails the run; "unknown" warns until its pending-owner-until, then fails; "never" needs a note saying why. __tests__/credential-register.test.ts requires a row for every secret a workflow reads, and for every secret the code reads (TASK-212, N-33); "unknown" needs "pending-owner-until" (at most 90 days ahead) and "owner-step", and fails once that day has passed (N-32). Certificates are also checked from their own notAfter at boot and at readiness (platform/observability/certificate-expiry.ts). How to rotate each: docs/ROTATION_RUNBOOK.md. platform-foundation has no deployment of its own: an app keeps its own register (sync-excluded), with its deployment's credentials as well as its workflows'.

credentials.note: Created by the owner with this expiry.
